newsitem.title: USA: Optical Coating expects lower Q4 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Optical Coating expects lower Q4 earnings.

text.p: Optical Coating Laboratory Inc said on Wednesday it expects fourth quarter earnings per share to fall significantly below the year-earlier $0.12.
The company cited delays in shipping products due to new manufacturing equipment coming online more slowly than originally scheduled.
Although the delays are expected to have a negative effect on results for the fourth quarter and full year, ending October, the company said overall demand and backlog remain relatively strong.

The shipment delays involve a new high-volume, flat-glass continuous coating machine, called a C-9, and a new roll-to-roll continuous coating machine at Flex Products Inc, an Optical Coating subsidiary.

Optical Coating said that during the fourth quarter the C-9 was successfully converted from a multi-pass to a single-pass production mode. It is scheduled to begin operation during three shifts on September 22.
